_about: Netbird groups and policies for SBAM (E16.3, #142, TD 20.5). This file is the source of truth that the Netbird dashboard (or API/Terraform) must match; scripts/netbird_matrix.py computes the expected reachability matrix from it and, on a Netbird peer, probes the live network against it. Every policy is one-way (source initiates). The default 'All to All' policy of a new Netbird account MUST be deleted, otherwise this file is bypassed. Applying it needs a Netbird admin and was not done by this change (docs/runbooks/environments.md, section Netbird).

groups.platform: platform developers only; the only humans who reach vm-prod ops ports
groups.backup-host: off-host backup server (E16.5): restic rest-server, append-only for the VMs
groups.ci-deploy: GitHub Actions deploy jobs (E16.4): ephemeral peers, one per job, from a reusable setup key

ssh.note: sshd listens on the Netbird address only

portal.note: dev and staging portals are private: their proxy binds to the Netbird address. Prod's 443 is public and needs no policy

keycloak-admin.note: KEYCLOAK_PORT: the Keycloak console and admin REST (the proxy never routes them)

backup.note: restic rest-server on the backup host (compose/backup/compose.backup-host.yaml)

sandbox-api.note: CubeAPI on the sandbox host (control plane: create, list, kill). CUBE_API_URL

sandbox-proxy.note: CubeProxy on the sandbox host (data plane: exec and file upload, plain HTTP, the SDK's only path). CUBE_PROXY_NODE_IP and CUBE_PROXY_PORT_HTTP. Without it a worker can create VMs and never run a test in one (E13.2 build log, flaw 3)

policies.name: laptops-to-dev-staging-ops
policies.description: Developer laptops reach the dev and staging VMs: SSH and the ops UIs. Never vm-prod.

policies.name: platform-to-vm-ops
policies.description: Platform developers reach every VM's SSH and ops UIs, including production.

policies.name: platform-to-sandbox-host-ssh
policies.description: Platform developers administer the sandbox host.

policies.name: vms-to-sandbox-api
policies.description: Workers (on the VMs) call the sandbox host: CubeAPI to create and destroy VMs, CubeProxy to run tests in them. The sandbox host initiates nothing.

policies.name: vms-to-backup-host
policies.description: Each VM's nightly backup uploads to its own append-only repository. The backup host initiates nothing.

policies.name: platform-to-backup-host-ssh
policies.description: Platform developers administer the backup host (retention, restore keys).

policies.name: ci-deploy-to-vms
policies.description: Deploy jobs SSH to each VM's deploy user (scripts/ci-deploy.sh) and smoke-check the private dev/staging portals. No ops UI; prod's portal is public.

policies.name: ci-deploy-to-private-portals
policies.description: Post-deploy smoke checks of the dev and staging portals, which bind to their Netbird address.

open_items: Dev and staging proxies are private, so ACME HTTP-01 cannot validate them: use SBAM_TLS=internal or provided certificates there.
